estimates: The standing profile represents the historic building documented by the conservation survey before the announced renovation. Final renovation alterations and the cultural village are outside the model.
The concrete louvres, window spacing, shade of exterior finishes, saw-leaf sections, roof junctions and additions are architectural estimates. The original survey’s photos and drawings were excluded.

review.notes: Checked the published Qualla gallery first and used no photographs or graphic reference material. The conservation team’s written survey, official records, named footprint and original terrain provide the controls.
